notes:
Lead: Veridian operates an omnichannel retail ops platform. Primary ask: reduce AHT and shrink ticket backlog via automated first-touch + agent assist. Key constraints: EU data residency for EU customers, strict retention policy for PII, SSO/SAML, and ability to run POC inside VPC.

POC goals (customer language): "Show me accurate citations back to KB, keep answers fresh within 24h, and handle 2x to 3x traffic spikes without tail latency blowups." They emphasized multi-source retrieval — Zendesk tickets, Confluence docs, product changelogs, and a SQL metadata store.

Technical targets (customer): 95th-pctl latency <250ms for agent assist responses, end-to-end ticket summary in <700ms, throughput ~400 req/s baseline with autoscaling headroom to 1k/s for peaks. Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity if we can show 30-40% unit-cost savings vs current managed endpoints.

Desired behavior: citations with document id + line refs, freshness / incremental re-indexing daily, reranking to prefer latest changelog entries, and a safe tool-calling surface to create/update tickets and escalate to human agents. They asked for fallback policy: if main model saturated, route to smaller distilled model + queueing with SLA-driven timeouts.

Sales notes: SE (Ravi) to own POC design; legal loop on retention and export controls. Customer quoted: "We need reliability during Black Friday — can't have degraded accuracy when traffic spikes."

Stubs/links: Drive deck (pricing + architecture), Fireflies call ids above, Jira tickets for security items. Next: deliver POC runbook + sample retrieval pipeline config (scoring, chunking, citation format).
use_case_summary: Veridian is evaluating a RAG-first agent-assist system to augment contact center agents and automate first-touch resolution. Requirements: multi-source retrieval (Zendesk + Confluence + changelogs + SQL index), citation provenance, daily freshness, low-latency streaming responses for agents, deterministic reranking rules, and robust degradation strategies during spikes (fallback models, queueing, circuit-breakers). POC scope: ingest 6 months of support history, validate summarization fidelity on 1k tickets, run load test to 2x expected peak.
